newsitem.title: CHINA: China copper prices seen following world trend.
newsitem.headline: China copper prices seen following world trend.

text.p: China's domestic copper prices in May will follow fluctuations in the international market with only marginal price changes, the China Daily said on Thursday.

Low domestic prices and high international prices would be maintained until domestic demand for copper surged, the newspaper said, quoting the Antaike Information Corp under the China National Non-Ferrous Metals Industry Corp.
China produced 211,400 tonnes of refined copper in the first quarter of 1997, up 9.38 percent over the year-ago period, the newspaper said.
China imported 13,012 tonnes of refined cooper between January and March, down 8.35 percent compared with the year-ago period, it said.
Copper exports skyrocketed a year-on-year 305 percent to 24,061 tonnes, the newspaper said.
It attributed the drop in copper imports and the rise in exports to the gap between international and domestic prices.
Imported copper was mostly roughly processed while exported copper was thoroughly processed, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
